# TableWise

> TableWise is a session coach for live casino table games. Players enter the amount they are playing with,
> tap the last results at their table, and get a signal for every bet: which side (e.g. Red or Black, Player or
> Banker) and exactly how much. It tracks a profit target and a loss limit live and tells the player when to cash
> out or stop. It works beside any online or land-based casino; it does not take bets or hold money.

## What it does
- Signal Room: personal session plan from the player's amount; side and amount for every bet; live progress to target; STOP and cash-out alerts; check-ins; session history.
- Practice tables: free play-money Roulette, Baccarat, Dragon Tiger, Sic Bo and Lucky 7 with the same signals.
- Strategy Lab: simulate betting systems over thousands of sessions.
- Personal colour themes (Neon, High Roller, Classic, Ember).

## Games
Roulette (red/black), Baccarat (player/banker), Dragon Tiger, Sic Bo (small/big), Lucky 7.

## Pricing (USD)
- Free: 3 hours of full access after sign-up, no card. Practice tables free forever.
- Day Pass: $20 (24 hours).
- Monthly: $140 (30 days).
- Yearly: $999 (365 days).
Passes do not auto-renew. Payment by PayPal, card or crypto.

## Important
Casino games are random and the house keeps an edge; TableWise does not guarantee wins and some sessions lose.
For adults 18+ where online casino games are legal. Responsible-gambling tools: session limits, check-ins, self-exclusion.
